mapper.select: SELECT b.*,u.display_name AS created_by_name,g.name AS owner_group_name FROM t_knowledge_base b LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=b.created_by LEFT JOIN t_user_group g ON g.id=b.owner_group_id WHERE b.status<>'ARCHIVED' AND (b.visibility='PUBLIC' OR b.created_by=#{userId} OR (b.owner_group_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_user_group_member m WHERE m.group_id=b.owner_group_id AND m.user_id=#{userId}))) AND b.visibility='PUBLIC' ORDER BY b.created_time DESC

SELECT b.*,u.display_name AS created_by_name,g.name AS owner_group_name FROM t_knowledge_base b LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id=b.created_by LEFT JOIN t_user_group g ON g.id=b.owner_group_id WHERE b.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_base SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_knowledge_base SET created_by=#{createdBy} WHERE id=#{id} AND created_by IS NULL
